claims.content: Non-C2 JU
C2 JUs are participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages and transmitting surveillance information in Network PGs.
The Non-C2 JU is monitoring the Surveillance NPG.
Remote surveillance track and point data is available in the J3 series messages.
A C2 JU transmits surveillance information in Network PGs via J3 Surveillance messages (J3.2, J3.3, J3.5).

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU transmits surveillance information in Network PGs via J3 Surveillance messages (J3.2, J3.3, J3.5).

claims.content: The Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG.
The information includes track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages provides situational awareness and early warning information.
If the Non-C2 JU is operating on Needline PGs, data filtering rules at sub-paragraphs a. through j. apply.
If the storage files of the JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of the new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority.
Any track or non-C2 IU with an EMG IND or WT IND set to the value of 1 shall not be filtered.
A J3.1 message shall not be filtered.
Remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
The transmission of EW product information shall be terminated when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.
The information may be purged in accordance with system design.
When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information, that it has been reporting on the interface, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted on remote reports.
Remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
The Non-C2 JU has received situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
The Non-C2 JU has been provided situational awareness and early warning information.
